Title: Anub'arak and Azmodan Patch
Subtitle: Technical Alpha patch 0.6.0.32455 (October 7, 2014, article 16081848) adding playable Heroes Anub'arak and Azmodan alongside the final planned account wipe and Battle.net balance refund, Double XP Week, Reaper of Souls Valla bonus, Custom Games with Observers, Observer UI, Replay System, Infested Tychus Legendary skin, Master Skins, gameplay/battleground updates, hero/talent changes, and bug fixes.
Affected: Li Li's prices have been reduced to 2
000 and $3.99 USD ETC's prices have been reduced to 2
Highlights: Technical Alpha patch 0.6.0.32455 (October 7, 2014, article 16081848) adding playable Heroes Anub'arak and Azmodan alongside the final planned account wipe and Battle.net balance refund, Double XP Week, Reaper of Souls Valla bonus, Custom Games with Observers, Observer UI, Replay System, Infested Tychus Legendary skin, Master Skins, gameplay/battleground updates, hero/talent changes, and bug fixes.
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Updates]
  • Account Wipe & Refund: Final planned Technical Alpha account wipe and monetary refund; real-money purchases were reset and refunded to Battle.net balance (with future real-money and Gold purchases intended to be permanent), while Gold, Gold purchases, XP, Hero/Player levels, Daily Quests, and rewards were wiped.
  • Double XP Week: One week of double XP in matchmaking modes (Practice, Cooperative, and Versus).
  • Diablo III: Reaper of Souls Bonus: Valla unlocked for Technical Alpha testers who pre-ordered Reaper of Souls (and for future invited players who pre-ordered).
  • Region & Friends List: Moved players to their home Battle.net region and switched to the shared Blizzard friends list (previous Technical Alpha friend lists were lost), allowing cross-game chat and status visibility; noted upcoming China, Korea, and Taiwan testing/Shop support and Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese translations.
  • User Interface:
  • - Custom Games: Re-enabled with up to 10 player slots and 2 observer slots, AI fill button, host controls (Swap Team, Kick from Lobby, Set A.I. difficulty, Promote to Host), and Ready/Start Game flow.
  • - Observer UI: Added initial Observer UI for Custom Games and Replays displaying selected Heroes, remaining Forts, Takedowns, match timer, Core Health, team levels, and XP progress.
  • - Replay System: Added initial Replay viewer via the Watch button with Pause/Resume (P), speed up (=), slow down (-), and timeline scrubbing (T).
  • - Profile & Queue UI: Fixed portrait clipping in Player Profile, prevented accessing locked skin variations while queued in a party, and allowed swapping unlocked skins and mounts while in matchmaking queue.
  • Art & Sound:
  • - Battlegrounds: Updated art for Capturable Beacons and Watchtowers (Heroes can now stand on and travel over Watchtowers) and VFX for the Mage Knight Mercenary.
  • - Heroes, Mounts & Skins: Re-released Infested Tychus as the first Legendary Skin with Zerg-themed ability art, models, VFX, sound effects, and voiceover; added dance, victory, and taunt animations for many Heroes; improved talent clarity and VFX for Muradin's Haymaker, Nova's Holo Decoy, and Tassadar's Twilight Archon; visually updated Commander Raynor variations, Gazlowe/Big Top Gazlowe/variations, Master Muradin/variations, Nazeebo/Grimskull Nazeebo/variations, and Dire Wolf/variations; added menu music.
  • Shop & Mounts:
  • - Noted partial payments using Battle.net Balance are not supported.
  • - Added Azgul'dan Azmodan and Cyb'arak Anub'arak Bundles plus Second Chance Bundle Week (all prior Alpha bundles re-enabled for one week).
  • - Added Anub'arak and Azmodan; reduced Chen's Gold price from 15,000 to 10,000 and Li Li and E.T.C. prices to $3.99 USD or 2,000 Gold.
  • - Added Az'guldan Azmodan, Cyb'arak Anub'arak, revamped Legendary Infested Tychus, and Master Skins for Anub'arak, Azmodan, Chen, Gazlowe, Murky, Nazeebo, and Sgt. Hammer.
  • - Mount updates: Wonder Billie (with portrait) awarded for any real-money purchase during Alpha/Closed Beta; Armored War Steed (Starter Bundle); Battle Beast free for mount-using Heroes (default for Stitches, Diablo, and Murky); Golden Cyber Wolf (Battle Bundle); Nazeebra (Nexus Bundle); Nexus Charger (BlizzCon 2014 attendees/Virtual Ticket); Piggy Bank (Gold only).
  • Design & Gameplay: Prevented casting most abilities on the minimap (global abilities such as Nova's Precision Strike and Tyrande's Sentinel still work); added a new Tutorial mission covering Talent selection and basic Battleground mechanics.
  • Battlegrounds & Structures: Stopped minimap icon blinking during combat for Haunted Mines Grave Golem and Garden of Terror Garden Terrors; reduced minion-vs-minion damage to strengthen unattended lane pushes; made Garden Terror Ready text blink when about to expire; changed Knight Mercenary Camp Healer to cast a damaging Arcane Bolt instead of healing allies; changed Core shield regeneration delay from 10s to 8s and Tower/Fort/Keep ammo regeneration interval from 10s to 15s.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Corrected several typos and tooltip errors across various aspects of the game.
  • Black placement indicators now appear properly for Zagara's Creep Tumor and Nydus Network on Low graphics settings.
  • Attacking a Mercenary Camp right as it spawns no longer resets defending Mercenaries' Health mid-fight.
  • Garden Terror is now immune to an opposing Garden Terror's Spore Queen's Curse.
  • Hero portraits in the Player Profile no longer extend outside their container.
  • Fixed an issue allowing players to access locked Skin Variations while queuing in a party.
  • Players can now swap unlocked Skins and Mounts while searching for a match in the matchmaking queue.
[Updates]
  • Stunning Heroes just before they finish channeling certain Heroic Abilities no longer places the Ability on reduced cooldown without interrupting the cast.

=== Talents ===
[Updates]
  • Protective Shield: Shield value changed from 300 (+30 per level) to 185 (+35 per level).

=== Heroes: Abathur ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Can now properly channel Cursed Hollow Tributes and enter/exit Haunted Mines after Ultimate Evolution expires.
  • Inherits the skin and color variations of allies copied with Ultimate Evolution.

=== Heroes: Anub'arak ===
[Updates]
  • New Hero Released — Anub'arak:
  • - Trait — Scarab Host (D): Spawns a Beetle whenever an Ability is cast.
  • - Impale (Q): Fires a line of spikes that damages and stuns enemies.
  • - Harden Carapace (W): Grants a Shield.
  • - Burrow Charge (E): Burrows underground and charges in a direction.
  • - Locust Swarm (R): Spawns a swarm of Locusts that damage enemies and heal Anub'arak.
  • - Web Blast (R): Wraps an enemy in webbing that enemies can attack to free their ally.

=== Heroes: Arthas ===
[Updates]
  • Rune Tap (Talent): Healing reduced from 6% to 4% of maximum Health.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Ghouls summoned by Army of the Dead no longer die instantly when Arthas is caught by Zagara's Devouring Maw.

=== Heroes: Azmodan ===
[Updates]
  • New Hero Released — Azmodan:
  • - Trait — General of Hell (D): Summons a Demon Lieutenant to assist Minions, Mercenaries, and Summons.
  • - Globe of Annihilation (Q): Launches a long-range orb dealing area damage.
  • - Summon Demon Warrior (W): Summons a Demon Warrior.
  • - All Shall Burn (E): Channels a death beam on an enemy.
  • - Demonic Invasion (R): Summons a rain of Demonic Grunts dealing damage on impact.
  • - Black Pool (R): Creates a pool that empowers Azmodan and his army.

=== Heroes: Brightwing ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Polymorph no longer occasionally causes the target to become invisible while polymorphed.

=== Heroes: Chen ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Can now properly enter the Haunted Mines during Storm, Earth, Fire.
  • Flying Kick no longer stops working after Stitches' Hook pulls him into an impassable object.

=== Heroes: Diablo ===
[Updates]
  • Black Soulstone (Trait):
  • - Devil's Due (Talent): Resurrection cost reduced from 75 to 60 Souls.
  • - Endless Death (Talent): Maximum Soul cap reduced from 200 to 150.
  • Overpower (E):
  • - Demonic Strength (Talent): Damage bonus increased from +25% to +50%.
  • - Soul Steal (Talent): Grants 5 Souls on use instead of 3; scaling per level increased from 8 to 9.
  • Lightning Breath (R): Duration reduced from 5s to 4s; damage ticks reduced from 11 to 9; scaling damage per tick increased from +8 to +9 per level.

=== Heroes: E.T.C. ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Guitar Solo no longer causes a slight delay before the next Basic Attack after learning Guitar Hero.
  • Dance Your Pants Off! Talent can no longer stun Grave Golems.

=== Heroes: Falstad ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Dealing fatal damage to a Dragon Knight or Garden Terror with Stormhammer no longer causes the player inside to permanently lose control of their Hero.

=== Heroes: Gazlowe ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Reduce, Reuse, Recycle Talent no longer causes summoned units to drop Scrap on death.

=== Heroes: Kerrigan ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Can no longer become invulnerable for the duration of Assimilation Shield after landing a killing blow on an enemy Tyrael or Uther.

=== Heroes: Li Li ===
[Updates]
  • Healing Brew (Q): No longer grants allies Mana regeneration.

=== Heroes: Malfurion ===
[Updates]
  • Entangling Roots (E):
  • - Vengeful Roots (Talent): Treant scaling damage reduced from +8 to +6 per level.

=== Heroes: Murky ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • No longer benefits from Zagara's Creep Tumor Movement Speed bonus.
  • If Murky's Egg is destroyed at the exact time he would have respawned, he now respawns at the Egg's former location.

=== Heroes: Nova ===
[Updates]
  • Talent & Kit Update: Removed Battle Momentum, Extended Projection (replaced by Remote Delivery), Focused Attacks, Follow Through (replaced by One in the Chamber), FN92 Sniper, Remote Access, and Vampiric Assault.
  • Basic Attack: Attack speed reduced from 1.25 to 1.0 attacks per second; base damage increased from 35 to 40.
  • - One in the Chamber (Level 7 Talent): Next Basic Attack after using an Ability deals +50% damage.
  • - Hot Shots (Level 7 Talent): Attacks three times slower but deals 330% damage per Basic Attack.
  • Cloak (Trait):
  • - Advanced Cloaking (Talent): Removed Health regeneration while Cloaked; Basic Abilities now cool down 25% faster in addition to the 25% Movement Speed bonus while Cloaked.
  • Snipe (Q): Cooldown reduced from 12s to 10s; base damage increased from 100 to 120; scaling damage per level changed from +35 to +34; Mana cost reduced from 75 to 65.
  • - Psi-Op Rangefinder (Talent): Also reduces Snipe cooldown by 2s in addition to +20% range.
  • - Booster Shot (Level 4 Talent): Hitting an enemy Hero with Snipe refunds 50% Mana cost; killing an enemy Hero refunds 100% Mana cost.
  • - Rail Gun (Talent): Also reduces Snipe cooldown by 1s per enemy hit in addition to piercing enemies.
  • Pinning Shot (W): Cooldown reduced from 15s to 12s; base damage reduced from 50 to 40; Mana cost reduced from 80 to 65; scaling damage per level changed from +18 to +10.
  • - Focused Fire (Level 4 Talent): Reduces Pinning Shot cooldown by 1s whenever Nova deals damage to a target slowed by Pinning Shot.
  • - Covert Ops (Level 7 Talent): Reduces Pinning Shot Mana cost by 5 per second spent Cloaked (minimum 0).
  • - Crippling Shot (Talent): Also makes targets Vulnerable (+25% damage taken) for the duration of the slow.
  • Holo Decoy (E): Now attacks and casts Abilities on enemies by default and matches Nova's Cloak state on cast.
  • - Digital Shrapnel (Talent): Explosion radius increased by 30% and reduces Holo Decoy cooldown by 2s.
  • - Remote Delivery (Talent, renamed from Extended Projection): Also increases Holo Decoy vision range by 100%.
  • - Double Fake (Level 16 Talent): Creates an additional Decoy at Nova's current location on cast, and Decoys gain movement AI.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Bonuses from Advanced Cloaking are properly lost upon breaking Cloak.

=== Heroes: Raynor ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Bullseye Talent no longer allows Penetrating Round to stun Structures or Grave Golems.

=== Heroes: Rehgar ===
[Updates]
  • Lightning Shield (W):
  • - Earth Shield (Talent): Shield amount changed from 200 (+17 per level) to 100 (+21 per level).

=== Heroes: Sonya ===
[Updates]
  • Seismic Slam (W):
  • - Furious Blow (Talent): Damage bonus reduced from 50% to 30%.

=== Heroes: Tassadar ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Second Strike Talent no longer allows Psionic Storm to be cast repeatedly for free.

=== Heroes: Tychus ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Heal-over-time effects on Tychus now properly transfer to the Odin upon activating Commandeer Odin.

=== Heroes: Tyrande ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Purging Arrow Talent no longer allows Basic Attacks from Minions, Mercenaries, and Summons to deplete ammo when Hunter's Mark targets a Structure.

=== Heroes: Valla ===
[Updates]
  • Hatred (Trait):
  • - Punishment (Talent): Hatred stacks granted on use increased from 2 to 3.
  • - Rancor (Talent): Attack speed bonus per Hatred stack reduced from 2% to 1.5%.
  • Strafe (R): Cooldown increased from 50s to 60s.
